QuestInfo.name: Gold Richie's Research Support
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2084001##k says he needs your help. Go see #b#p2084001##k.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9000021##k is developing a new tool for the Resistance at the request of #b#p2084001##k. After hearing that #b#p9000021##k is having difficulties with his research, #p2084001# asks that you meet #b#p9000021##k, then report back to him.
QuestInfo.2: You helped #b#p9000021##k gather materials for fuel and reported back to Gold Richie.

0.0: I want you to help me with something.

yes.0: Actually, I have one other person who's working for me part-time. You may have seen him around. Do you remember #b#p9000021##k?
yes.1: I asked #b#p9000021##k to invent a tool for the Resistance, and told him that I would support his experiment at all costs. Fortunately, that invention is almost complete.
yes.2: But today, out of nowhere, Gaga tells me he needs more Monster Purple Crystals. Can you find them for him?
yes.3: You should be able to find the #bMonster Purple Crystal#k from any monster, but at a pretty low rate. Gaga needs #b10#k of them. Once you collect them, please take them to Gaga.

no.0: I guess you're pretty busy... All right then.

1.0: Ahh... It must be done quickly...
1.1: You're the helper Gold Richie sent, right? You brought the Monster Purple Crystals?

yes.0: Hmm... It's almost complete? Great work. I'll show it to you when it's done.
yes.1: Please tell Gold Richie that I'm almost finished.

item.0: When are the materials going to arrive...

quest.0: Go to Gaga and help him develop a new tool.
